description: This file declares the class USBMassStorageImplementation which implements USB mass storage device management and configuration interfaces, including device notification handling, device listing, mounting, unmounting, and partition info retrieval within the WPEFramework plugin architecture.

classes.name: USBMassStorageImplementation
classes.description: Main class implementing USB mass storage and configuration interfaces, managing device notifications, device list, mount points, and partition info.

classes.name: USBDeviceNotification
classes.description: Inner class handling USB device plug-in and plug-out notifications, forwarding events to the parent implementation.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Dispatch class for handling asynchronous USB storage events such as mount and unmount.

methods.name: instance
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the USBMassStorageImplementation instance.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for USB mass storage events.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: GetDeviceList
methods.description: Retrieves the list of connected USB storage devices.

methods.name: GetMountPoints
methods.description: Retrieves mount points for a specified device.

methods.name: GetPartitionInfo
methods.description: Retrieves partition information for a given mount path.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the provided service.
